subject: Proposed hybrid commission structure for LumosAI partnership
messages:
From: Alex Turner <a.turner@lumosai.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@lumosai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed hybrid commission structure for LumosAI partnership

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. LumosAI is excited about embedding Redwood as the serving layer for our new "Answers+" module. Our VP of GTM asked me to push on commercial structure before we move into an engineering SOW.

We usually operate two models with ISV partners: a small monthly retainer to cover joint-engineering credits + a variable revenue share on consumption for customer-billed accounts that rely on our joint integration.

Attached is a starter term sheet (LumosAI-Redwood-term-sheet-v1.pdf) that outlines: 1) $6k/month joint-engineering retainer for the first 3 months, 2) 18% revenue share on direct billings where LumosAI invoices the customer and 12% where Redwood invoices and collects, and 3) a 45-day lead registration window with first-touch protection for registered leads.

Questions we have for Redwood:
- Would Redwood be open to a hybrid retainer + rev-share model like above?
- Can you confirm lead registration guardrails (what counts as a registered lead, how disputes escalate)?
- Typical payment terms on rev-share (net 30/45/60) and invoicing cadence?

Happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk through.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships, LumosAI
partners@lumosai.com

Attachment: LumosAI-Redwood-term-sheet-v1.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <a.turner@lumosai.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed hybrid commission structure for LumosAI partnership

Alex —

Thanks for sending this over and for the transparency. Redwood is open to hybrid models in principle; we've been piloting retainer + usage share structures with a couple of ISVs. I pulled some initial notes below. Would prefer to capture final terms in a short partner addendum + an SOW for engineering work.

Quick answers up-front:
- Retainer: we can do a time-limited engineering retainer ($5k/month for three months as a starting point) that converts to credits toward onboarding or co-marketing if not used.
- Revenue share: we typically standardize on 15% when the partner invoices and 10% when Redwood invoices, but we can be flexible for a first-of-its-kind integration — suggest 16% / 12% as a middle ground.
- Lead registration: we support a 60-day registration window and require evidence of first outreach (HubSpot form id, email thread, or shared demo invite). Disputes escalate to partner-ops and then to a designated exec for final arbitration.
- Payment terms: net 30 for Redwood-paid rev-share; if LumosAI pays Redwood and then owes rev-share, net 30 on remittance helps cash flow.

Cc'ing Marissa from partner ops and Ben from Sales to align on how registration evidence flows into our partner portal. Can you confirm whether the $6k retainer is refundable/creditable? Also attaching a draft SOW we use for integrations.

Would you be available for a call Friday 2/12 or Monday 2/15?

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW-integration-draft.docx (DOCX, 98 KB)

From: Alex Turner <a.turner@lumosai.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@lumosai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed hybrid commission structure for LumosAI partnership

Priya —

Thanks for the quick note and the range — that's useful. On the retainer, Lumos would prefer the retainer to be creditable against the first 6 months of rev-share (to keep incentives aligned). Not refundable otherwise.

For the lead registration, 60 days sounds reasonable. We can provide HubSpot record ids or signed intro emails as evidence. For escalation, our legal lead (Sabrina) prefers an explicit 2-step escalation: partner-ops review, then VP-level sign-off if unresolved.

Friday 2/12 at 10am PT works for a 30-45m sync. I've set a placeholder calendar invite.

— Alex

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: LumosAI commercial — registration + commission mechanics

Team — quick internal notes before Friday's call. Key risks and asks for legal/finance: 

1) Revenue recognition: if Lumos invoices, we need monthly statements and an agreed reconciliation cadence. Ops wants quarterly audits for the first year.
2) Lead registration evidence: require a single canonical source (HubSpot ID is ideal) to avoid duplicate crediting. Marissa: can you confirm portal intake flow?
3) Payment timing: prefer net 30 with 10-day review window for disputes before payment release. Try to avoid net 60 if possible.
4) Credits: We should standardize retainer-as-credit language (applies to first N invoice cycles and reduces rev-share payable until credit is consumed).

Marissa — can you draft the partner addendum template for review? Rishi — confirm if SE hours in the SOW need a 2-week notice for scheduling.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: LumosAI commercial — registration + commission mechanics

Ben / Team —

Happy to take this. I spun up a working draft of a partner addendum that includes: 60-day registration window, HubSpot ID as canonical evidence, retainer crediting language, and a 30-day net payment term. I also added a clause for co-marketing credits to be applied if both parties run joint campaigns within 6 months.

I'll drop the draft in the shared Drive (link below) and label it LUMOS_Redwood_PartnerAddendum_v0.1. Priya — can you please include the Lumos contact for legal (Sabrina) on the doc so both sides can comment?

Marissa Cole
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD-example-term-sheet

From: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@lumosai.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed hybrid commission structure for LumosAI partnership

Team —

Sabrina from Lumos legal here. We reviewed the draft and provided comments in the Drive doc. A couple of items to flag: 
- Escrow/holdback: Lumos requests a 5% holdback on rev-share for the first 120 days as a reconciliation buffer.
- Audit window: Lumos is okay with quarterly reconciliations but asks that audit requests be limited to twice per year and with 30-day notice.
- Clawback language: propose a 120-day clawback for refunds/chargebacks that materially impact reported revenue.

We're open to finalizing the partner addendum + SOW after addressing the above. Priya — can you confirm Redwood's position on the 5% holdback?

Best,
Sabrina Cole
General Counsel (acting), LumosAI
